name: Wisdom of Athena

features.name: Pay anywhere
features.description: Eight or more matching symbols anywhere on the 5x6 grid form a win.

features.name: Unlocking reel
features.description: Each tumble progresses towards revealing an extra reel, increasing the space for wins.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: 10 free spins with multipliers held for the whole round and reel progress kept between spins.

review:
Zeus's daughter takes over, on a 5x6 pay-anywhere grid that grows as you win. Eight or more matching symbols anywhere pay, and every tumble helps unlock an extra reel position.

In the 10 free spins, multipliers stay for the whole feature instead of resetting and stack together, and progress towards the extra reel carries over too, which gives the round real momentum. Up to 5,000x, 96.07% RTP. A twist on the Olympus formula.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
